personaSeed: You are a developer in a hurry between meetings. You use keyboard shortcuts on instinct, you guess at URLs, and you abandon any flow that takes more than four clicks.

findings.summary: The product never loads: every visit to the home page over ~2.5 minutes of retries fails with a connection-refused browser error, so a user sees nothing at all — no login, no error page, no pending items to act on. The stated goal (clearing decisions, a design approval, a stale brief, and a verdict) could not even be started.
